title: Case System vNext D1/D3/D5 Pilot Archetypes
description: Fifteen non-canonical archetypes covering five discipline profiles at D1, D3, and D5. These records define authoring structure only; they are not executable TutorEval cases, calibrated measures, or learner-outcome evidence.

archetypes.title: Mathematics D1 — Equivalent representations
archetypes.coreTask: Verify whether two familiar numerical representations are equivalent and explain one visible reason without taking over the learner's work.

humanOptimalInstanceStrategies.label: Direct equivalence
humanOptimalInstanceStrategies.keyInsight: Transform one representation into the other using one familiar equivalence move.
humanOptimalInstanceStrategies.applicability: Specific pairs where a direct rewrite is available.

humanOptimalGeneralStrategies.label: Normalize to a shared representation
humanOptimalGeneralStrategies.keyInsight: Convert both values into a common representation and compare.
humanOptimalGeneralStrategies.applicability: General comparison of familiar fraction/decimal/percent forms.

alternativeHumanValidStrategies.label: Visual model
alternativeHumanValidStrategies.keyInsight: Use an area or number-line representation to establish equivalence.
alternativeHumanValidStrategies.applicability: Useful when symbolic fluency is weak.

avoidableDetours: performing long arithmetic when a direct equivalence is visible

transfer.nearTransfer: Use the same equivalence principle with different values.
transfer.farTransfer: Recognize equivalence when the same quantity appears in a different representation.

archetypes.title: Mathematics D3 — Multi-step algebra diagnosis
archetypes.coreTask: Diagnose a consequential intermediate algebra error, preserve valid work, and guide the learner through the smallest useful correction.

humanOptimalInstanceStrategies.label: Repair the first invalid transformation
humanOptimalInstanceStrategies.keyInsight: Locate the earliest invalid equality-preserving move and correct only that step.
humanOptimalInstanceStrategies.applicability: A concrete equation with one localized error.

humanOptimalGeneralStrategies.label: Maintain equality invariant
humanOptimalGeneralStrategies.keyInsight: At each step apply an inverse operation to both sides, simplifying until the variable is isolated.
humanOptimalGeneralStrategies.applicability: General one-variable linear equations within the prerequisite boundary.

alternativeHumanValidStrategies.label: Back-substitution check
alternativeHumanValidStrategies.keyInsight: Test a proposed value in the original equation to localize whether the error is in solving or checking.
alternativeHumanValidStrategies.applicability: Useful for verification but not always the shortest repair.

avoidableDetours: restarting the entire solution despite correct intermediate work
repeating the same low-specificity hint after the same error

transfer.nearTransfer: Change coefficients while preserving the same error structure.
transfer.farTransfer: Transfer the equality-invariant reasoning to a word problem translated into an equation.

archetypes.title: Mathematics D5 — From instance insight to general method
archetypes.coreTask: Use a structurally efficient solution on a specific expression, then help the learner justify and generalize the underlying identity without presenting an unexplained shortcut.

humanOptimalInstanceStrategies.label: Exploit symmetric factors
humanOptimalInstanceStrategies.keyInsight: Recognize factors of the form (a-d)(a+d) and use a²-d².
humanOptimalInstanceStrategies.applicability: Instances with symmetric factors around a center.

humanOptimalGeneralStrategies.label: Derive difference of squares
humanOptimalGeneralStrategies.keyInsight: Expand (a-d)(a+d), show cancellation of middle terms, and state a²-d².
humanOptimalGeneralStrategies.applicability: All products of conjugate binomials within the stated algebra domain.

alternativeHumanValidStrategies.label: Full expansion
alternativeHumanValidStrategies.keyInsight: Multiply all terms and simplify.
alternativeHumanValidStrategies.applicability: Always valid here but mechanically longer for symmetric instances.

avoidableDetours: long multiplication after the symmetric structure is already accessible
stating the identity as a black box when derivation is the learning target

transfer.nearTransfer: Solve a new symmetric product with different center and offset.
transfer.farTransfer: Recognize the same identity inside a factoring or geometry problem.

archetypes.title: Science D1 — Direct representation interpretation
archetypes.coreTask: Read an explicit trend or value from a graph without adding a causal claim that the graph does not establish.

alternativeHumanValidStrategies.label: Read axes then trend
alternativeHumanValidStrategies.keyInsight: Identify variables and units, then state the observed relationship.

avoidableDetours: inventing a mechanism when only correlation is shown

transfer.nearTransfer: Read the same variables from a differently scaled graph.
transfer.farTransfer: Distinguish an observed association from a causal explanation in a short study description.

archetypes.title: Science D3 — Multi-variable causal explanation
archetypes.coreTask: Repair an explanation that confuses correlation, mechanism, and a relevant control variable while preserving supported parts of the learner's reasoning.

alternativeHumanValidStrategies.label: Mechanism plus control
alternativeHumanValidStrategies.keyInsight: Connect the proposed mechanism to observed evidence and identify a control or alternative variable that must be considered.
alternativeHumanValidStrategies.applicability: General causal explanation under limited evidence.

alternativeHumanValidStrategies.label: Competing hypotheses
alternativeHumanValidStrategies.keyInsight: State at least two plausible explanations and identify evidence that would discriminate them.
alternativeHumanValidStrategies.applicability: Useful when current evidence underdetermines cause.

avoidableDetours: treating correlation as proof of causation
listing variables without explaining their role

transfer.nearTransfer: Apply the same causal structure to a new experiment with changed surface variables.
transfer.farTransfer: Identify a confound in a different domain while preserving the same evidence logic.

archetypes.title: Science D5 — Design an investigation under uncertainty
archetypes.coreTask: Design an interpretable investigation that discriminates between competing explanations while making uncertainty, controls, and measurement limits explicit.

excludedMethods: claiming certainty from one noisy observation

alternativeHumanValidStrategies.label: Discriminating experiment
alternativeHumanValidStrategies.keyInsight: Vary the factor on which competing models make different predictions while controlling major confounds.

alternativeHumanValidStrategies.label: Triangulated evidence
alternativeHumanValidStrategies.keyInsight: Combine complementary measurements when one instrument or design cannot isolate the mechanism.

avoidableDetours: adding many measurements that do not discriminate the hypotheses
ignoring a known confound
treating absence of evidence as proof

transfer.nearTransfer: Modify one control variable and explain how the design must change.
transfer.farTransfer: Transfer the discrimination logic to a new scientific domain with different measurements.

archetypes.title: Programming D1 — Trace a local state change
archetypes.coreTask: Trace a short deterministic program and explain the specific state change responsible for the output.

excludedMethods: running the program as the only explanation

humanOptimalInstanceStrategies.label: Minimal trace
humanOptimalInstanceStrategies.keyInsight: Track only variables that affect the requested output through the relevant statements.
humanOptimalInstanceStrategies.applicability: Short deterministic programs with local state.

humanOptimalGeneralStrategies.label: Dependency-focused trace
humanOptimalGeneralStrategies.keyInsight: Follow data dependencies from inputs through assignments to the observed output.

alternativeHumanValidStrategies.label: Full state table
alternativeHumanValidStrategies.keyInsight: Record every variable after every line.

avoidableDetours: recording irrelevant state at every line

transfer.nearTransfer: Trace the same pattern with changed initial values.
transfer.farTransfer: Identify which assignments matter in a larger function with irrelevant local state.

archetypes.title: Programming D3 — Stateful debugging
archetypes.coreTask: Locate the earliest state transition that violates the intended invariant and guide a minimal repair rather than rewriting the whole program.

humanOptimalInstanceStrategies.label: Find the first bad state
humanOptimalInstanceStrategies.keyInsight: Trace only until the first invariant violation, then repair the responsible operation.
humanOptimalInstanceStrategies.applicability: A concrete deterministic bug with reproducible state corruption.

humanOptimalGeneralStrategies.label: Invariant-driven debugging
humanOptimalGeneralStrategies.keyInsight: State the intended invariant, instrument checkpoints, and narrow the first point where it fails.

alternativeHumanValidStrategies.label: Checkpoint narrowing
alternativeHumanValidStrategies.keyInsight: Place observations at coarse boundaries and narrow the failing region.

avoidableDetours: changing multiple components before localizing the fault
adding logging everywhere without a hypothesis

transfer.nearTransfer: Debug a structurally similar bug with a different container or loop.
transfer.farTransfer: Apply invariant-driven debugging to an asynchronous or recursive variant.

archetypes.title: Programming D5 — Derive a reusable algorithm
archetypes.coreTask: Move from a brute-force correct solution to a human-understandable efficient algorithm, justify the key data-structure insight, and distinguish the reusable method from an instance trick.

excludedMethods: opaque library solution with no reasoning

humanOptimalInstanceStrategies.label: Use complement lookup
humanOptimalInstanceStrategies.keyInsight: For each element, ask whether the required complement has already been seen.
humanOptimalInstanceStrategies.applicability: Concrete pair-sum instances under expected O(1) hash lookup.

humanOptimalGeneralStrategies.label: One-pass complement method
humanOptimalGeneralStrategies.keyInsight: Maintain a seen set/map so each item is processed once while checking its complement.
humanOptimalGeneralStrategies.applicability: General two-sum style existence/index problems under hashable values.

alternativeHumanValidStrategies.label: Sort and use two pointers
alternativeHumanValidStrategies.keyInsight: Sort values then move two pointers according to the current sum.
alternativeHumanValidStrategies.applicability: Valid with O(n log n) preprocessing and useful when ordering helps.

avoidableDetours: nested-pair enumeration when hash lookup is allowed and taught
giving code before explaining why complement lookup removes one loop

transfer.nearTransfer: Apply the method to a new target and changed input order.
transfer.farTransfer: Recognize the complement/inverse-query pattern in a related pair-matching problem.

archetypes.title: Language/Writing D1 — Local revision
archetypes.coreTask: Revise one sentence to satisfy an explicit clarity or grammar constraint while explaining the local change.

alternativeHumanValidStrategies.label: Minimal local edit
alternativeHumanValidStrategies.keyInsight: Change only the words or punctuation needed to satisfy the stated constraint.

avoidableDetours: rewriting the student's voice unnecessarily
changing meaning while fixing surface form

transfer.nearTransfer: Revise a new sentence with the same local issue.
transfer.farTransfer: Identify the same issue inside a paragraph without rewriting the paragraph wholesale.

archetypes.title: Language/Writing D3 — Repair argument coherence
archetypes.coreTask: Diagnose whether the main weakness is the claim, evidence, or warrant and guide a targeted revision while preserving defensible material.

alternativeHumanValidStrategies.label: Repair the weakest link
alternativeHumanValidStrategies.keyInsight: Identify the unsupported connection and revise the claim, evidence, or warrant that causes it.

alternativeHumanValidStrategies.label: Counterexample test
alternativeHumanValidStrategies.keyInsight: Test whether the claim overreaches by considering a plausible counterexample or limitation.

avoidableDetours: adding more evidence when the real problem is the warrant
rewriting the full paragraph before naming the reasoning gap

transfer.nearTransfer: Repair a new paragraph with the same claim-evidence mismatch.
transfer.farTransfer: Transfer the same diagnostic to a different genre or audience.

archetypes.title: Language/Writing D5 — Multi-source synthesis
archetypes.coreTask: Synthesize partially conflicting sources into an original argument with explicit evidence boundaries, uncertainty, and source attribution.

alternativeHumanValidStrategies.label: Claim-centered synthesis
alternativeHumanValidStrategies.keyInsight: Organize sources around a defensible claim, showing where evidence converges and diverges.

alternativeHumanValidStrategies.label: Tension-centered synthesis
alternativeHumanValidStrategies.keyInsight: Use a genuine disagreement or limitation among sources to structure the analysis.
alternativeHumanValidStrategies.applicability: Useful when sources do not support one simple consensus.

avoidableDetours: serially summarizing sources without synthesis
erasing uncertainty to make the argument sound stronger

transfer.nearTransfer: Synthesize a new source set with the same evidence pattern.
transfer.farTransfer: Transfer the synthesis strategy to a different genre, such as a policy memo.

archetypes.title: History/Social Science D1 — Explicit source interpretation
archetypes.coreTask: Identify an explicit source claim, speaker position, or chronological relationship without importing unsupported background assumptions.

alternativeHumanValidStrategies.label: Source-grounded reading
alternativeHumanValidStrategies.keyInsight: Anchor the answer to what the source explicitly states and distinguish that from inference.

avoidableDetours: adding motives or context not supported by the provided source

transfer.nearTransfer: Interpret a new source with the same explicit-evidence requirement.
transfer.farTransfer: Distinguish explicit evidence from inference in a source from a different period.

archetypes.title: History/Social Science D3 — Multi-cause explanation
archetypes.coreTask: Build or repair a causal explanation that distinguishes background conditions, triggers, mechanisms, and consequences using cited evidence.

alternativeHumanValidStrategies.label: Causal chain
alternativeHumanValidStrategies.keyInsight: Connect conditions, triggers, mechanisms, and outcomes while citing evidence at each major link.

alternativeHumanValidStrategies.label: Compare causal contributions
alternativeHumanValidStrategies.keyInsight: Evaluate several causes by scope, timing, and evidentiary support rather than naming only one.

avoidableDetours: listing causes without explaining mechanisms
treating chronology alone as causation

transfer.nearTransfer: Explain a different event using the same condition-trigger-mechanism structure.
transfer.farTransfer: Transfer multi-causal reasoning to a social-science policy outcome.

archetypes.title: History/Social Science D5 — Conflicting-source synthesis
archetypes.coreTask: Synthesize conflicting sources or interpretations, weigh provenance and evidence, state uncertainty, and identify what additional evidence would change the conclusion.

excludedMethods: declaring one source correct solely because it is primary

alternativeHumanValidStrategies.label: Corroboration matrix
alternativeHumanValidStrategies.keyInsight: Compare claims, provenance, incentives, and independent support before drawing a bounded conclusion.

alternativeHumanValidStrategies.label: Conditional interpretations
alternativeHumanValidStrategies.keyInsight: State which evidence would support each interpretation and where current evidence remains underdetermined.
alternativeHumanValidStrategies.applicability: Useful when disagreement cannot be resolved cleanly.

avoidableDetours: averaging conflicting claims into false consensus
equating source disagreement with equal evidentiary strength

transfer.nearTransfer: Evaluate a new source set with one changed provenance feature.
transfer.farTransfer: Transfer corroboration logic to conflicting statistical or policy claims.
